briefing: Markets dipped slightly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, so there was no clear direction. With only $445.88 in cash, below the $500 buy threshold, we are holding all 7 positions and keeping the cash for a stronger up day. DPC and IBP pass all four of our buy checks and are first in line when we next buy.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor keeps on hand so they can buy when a good opportunity comes along. Spending small amounts of cash on a flat, directionless day can lock you into weaker trades. Waiting for a clear up day usually gets you a better entry.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指投資者手上預留的現金，用來在好機會出現時入市。在方向不明的平淡日子勉強動用少量現金，容易買入質素較次的倉位；耐心等待市場明確轉強，入市時機通常更佳。

market_education.summary_en: Stocks slipped slightly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, a small move that does not change the overall trend. No news headlines were supplied for this session, so we cannot point to a specific cause, and moves this small are often just normal day-to-day trading. Under the surface, many small and mid-sized stocks such as DPC, IBP and HUBS still showed strong momentum on heavier trading, so buyers have not left the market.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日小幅回落，納斯達克指數跌0.4%，標普500指數跌0.3%，波幅輕微，未改變整體走勢。本節未有提供新聞資料，難以確定具體推手，而如此輕微的波動，往往只屬日常買賣的正常起伏。值得留意的是，DPC、IBP、HUBS等中小型股仍然量價齊升，動能強勁，顯示資金並未撤離市場。
